gloss: Honnō-ji, the Kyoto temple where Oda Nobunaga died

definitions.explanation: A Buddhist temple in Kyoto, best known as the place where {織田信長|おだのぶなが} was attacked by his own general {明智光秀|あけちみつひで} in 1582 and died. The event, {本能寺|ほんのうじ}の{変|へん}, is one of the most famous turning points in Japanese history.

examples.english: The Honnō-ji Incident took place in 1582.

examples.japanese: {信長|のぶなが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本能寺|ほんのうじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とした→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
examples.english: Nobunaga lost his life at Honnō-ji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧{光秀|みつひで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{本能寺|ほんのうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{襲|おそ}った→襲う：01915_osou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: In history class we discussed why Mitsuhide attacked Honnō-ji.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {本能寺|ほんのうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧: the Honnō-ji Incident (1582)
- ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{本能寺|ほんのうじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧: "the real enemy is at Honnō-ji"; said when one's true aim differs from the stated one (Mitsuhide's words as he turned his army on Nobunaga)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- The temple was rebuilt on a different site after the incident; the present Honnō-ji stands near Kyoto City Hall.
